data.title: Feyenoord receive very lenient punishment from KNVB for fireworks violence in Leeuwarden | Yardbarker
data.content:
The KNVB have fined Feyenoord €7,500 and handed them a suspended punishment over the fireworks violence at their away match against SC Cambuur on 23 August, the association announced through its official channels on Wednesday.

In the 12th minute of the match between Cambuur and Feyenoord, Feyenoord supporters set off fireworks en masse. Some landed in a section containing Cambuur supporters, injuring seven people. [...] ### Follow Us
